text: Keep your intention simple today; choose what is small but consistent.
A brief connection with the Quran can strengthen the balance of your day.
As iftar approaches, whisper a dua that softens your heart.
At the end of the day, a short gratitude list can quiet the mind.
Slowing down is also worship; reduce hurry and increase awareness.
Setting aside time to understand one ayah is enough for a good start today.
No act of sharing is too small; a kind word is also charity.
Protecting your intention from suhoor to iftar helps gather the heart.
A short reflection in the quiet of night gives rest to the soul.
Try being gentler with yourself and others today.
While waiting for iftar, try forgiving someone sincerely.
Read one surah slowly today; let meaning come without rush.
Fast with your heart as well as your tongue: speak without hurting.
Speak less, give more thanks. Make a small gratitude list today.
Do a quiet good deed for someone. Let it stay unknown.
When you make dua today, do not forget yourself: mercy first settles within.
Meet the Quran not as a task, but as a reunion.
One minute of silence today: only breath and intention.
When you feel tired, simplify: fewer goals, cleaner heart.
